name: random-window sampling repair
status: frozen after diagnosing v2.7 prefix/cyclic-stream mismatch and before any corrected profile or training outcome
scope: paired protocol repair on the same 54 development and 24 confirmation corpora; not a new source-disjoint confirmation
hypothesis: Marginal Fourier locality sampled across the corpus predicts normalized learning time under random-window Transformer training.

sampling.unit: contiguous next-token window; individual tokens are never shuffled
sampling.train_windows: uniform with replacement over eligible starts in train blocks
sampling.profile_windows: uniform without replacement over eligible starts in profile blocks
sampling.validation_windows: 2048 fixed uniform-without-replacement starts in validation blocks, identical across learner seeds
sampling.document_limitation: historical streams lack a universal document index; disjoint 16KiB blocks prevent the ordered-prefix and adjacent-tail split failure but do not reconstruct documents

profile.basis: inverse-likelihood categorical projection under the sampled dependent data measure

prediction.model: standardized unpenalized one-feature OLS fit on all 54 corrected development outcomes

decision.confirmed: RMSE improvement interval strictly above zero and blocked rank rho positive with one-sided p <= 0.05
